_doc: Which Copilot model and effort each role uses, and how the ladders climb. Fleet-owned: edit only in lm, synced to every repo by sync-fleet-files.yml. CLI sessions read it through scripts/copilot-setup/install.sh; AB's fix pipeline reads coding.ladder (FIX_MODEL_LADDER), so one change here reaches every system. Evidence: lm/docs/agents-and-skills.md, 'The model policy'.

coordinator._doc: The interactive CLI session: plans, scopes, reviews diffs, runs tests, commits. It does not write code itself beyond edits of a few lines.

coding._doc: Cheapest rung first. Climb one rung only when the tests still fail, passing up the failing tests, not the failed attempt. The last rung is the coordinator (CLI) or AB's Opus-class last turn.

review._doc: ADOPTED for local sessions (review skill): each panel prompt goes to ONE reviewer at a time. Start on the cheapest rung; climb to the frontier seat (a different vendor from the code's author) only when the cheap verdict is disputed (a Reject the author shows is wrong with file evidence) or its confidence is below climb_below. The frontier verdict stands. AB's own panels still use fix_engine's panel allowlist until AB is changed to read this section.
